claim.text: All ADC samples are unsigned 12-bit integers, 0..4095.
claim.scope: The declared synthetic ADC input-domain assumption for AS-001 only.

rationale: BKP-ADC-001 expressly declares the toy-device legal input domain as unsigned integers [0,4095]. C-001 matches that domain exactly. Because AS-001 and VP-001 define C-001 as an explicitly synthetic architectural exercise and make the BKP specification its AS-stage evidence, this declaration is adequate authority for the model assumption. It is not evidence that any physical ADC has this output range or behavior.
assumptions: The exercise is synthetic and the declared BKP-ADC-001 model defines legal inputs to the architecture.
No claim is made about analog accuracy, distortion, physical ADC behavior, or sample-loss guarantees.
limitations: Does not verify or certify physical hardware.
Does not approve an AP, alter F-001 or AS-001, or discharge any obligation other than VO-001 within this scope.
Structural checks and unit tests are not evidence for this acceptance decision.
